name: desktop-selected-view
goal: Show the selected second level in the Desktop multiple-view catalog state

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The multiple-view fixture adds a second hidden select option while keeping the first view active. Its screenshot cannot visibly establish a second selected view.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing GameViewFields multiple case checks only hidden option count. Extend its post-capture assertion for the selected second identity and visible title.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 82a83a69119dcf8ec48b02d98c4f58af785bd8e8ba03d7f0dc6bf23026a02aba; all three existing multiple cases show only the first view. Original failing images inspected.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The multiple fixture now supplies the real second active view together with both available views. The existing settings interaction exposes its selected name and title; product and default contracts stay unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
